chunks: And Zachariah and John and Jesus and Elias, all of them were among the upright.
ai.seo_question: Who are the four prophets mentioned as being among the righteous in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the continuity of prophethood by listing Zachariah, John, Jesus, and Elias as part of the 'righteous' (al-Salihin), a title often associated with the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia exegesis for their spiritual purity. It underscores the unity of the divine message across different eras, affirming their status not just as messengers but as exemplars of piety and moral excellence.
